items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: No. This is another Jimmy Smith. This is Jimmy Smith from Memphis, Tennessee. He used to play with Red Calhoun's band.

ctx.x: That's Jimmy Smith, the organ player?

No. This is another Jimmy Smith. This is Jimmy Smith from Memphis, Tennessee. He used to play with Red Calhoun's band. He's a great piano player. A little-bitty old short fellow. Play a whole lot of piano.
You see, one of the things that has impressed me... I've been to a few Black churches in the States from time to time. I really enjoy it.
